text: One month full, the next month nothing. Here's why.
spoken: Some months clients, other months nothing? Your posts know why.
visual: Claymation, one clay wall calendar, two pages side by side: the left month crowded with little clay clients, the right month bare

text: Full month or empty month? Here's how to know.
spoken: Will next month be full, or nothing? Your posts already know.
visual: Claymation, a clay owner's hand holds up a calendar page for next month, blank, with a big clay question mark on it

text: "Post more." No. Post what clients ask about.
spoken: Some months nothing? You don't need more posts. You need one.
visual: Claymation, a tall wobbling stack of clay post cards beside an empty calendar month

text: Empty months? Post what you sell, then watch who asks.
spoken: Just post what you sell. See which post gets clients asking.
visual: Claymation, three clay posts on a phone; clay hands with questions reach toward only one of them

text: Only one kind of post brings consistent clients
spoken: Want consistent clients? Stop posting your tips, memes and trends.
visual: Claymation, clay posts marked TIPS, MEMES and TRENDS slide off a phone into a bin; one plain post stays

text: Only one post shows if next month fills up
spoken: One post tells me if your next month is empty.
visual: Claymation, one clay post with a face holds up next month's calendar page

text: "My posts get zero leads." Here's why.
spoken: Your posts get zero leads? You never asked who's buying.
visual: Claymation, a clay post shouts into a megaphone in an empty clay room

text: One month full, one month empty. Post this instead.
spoken: If your months swing like this, here's what I'd post.
visual: Claymation, a clay seesaw with a calendar month page on each end: one end pressed down by a crowd of little clay clients, the other end up in the air, empty

text: Some months nothing? Stop guessing what to post.
spoken: You shouldn't guess what to post. You should let clients pick.
visual: Claymation, a clay post card with a face wears a blindfold, standing in front of an empty calendar month

text: Feast and famine months? It starts with your posts.
spoken: Every month starting from nothing? Your posts can tell you why.
visual: Claymation, a clay calendar: one month a full table of clay clients, the next an empty plate
